workerResult.summary: Staircase Ballads: a japanese-minimal generative poem machine. Each spacebar step writes a lyric line from a weather theme (Rain/Wind/Snow/Moon/Dusk) into a vertical-rl handscroll, climbs an SVG stair with a stone figure, and counts steps/floors. Twelve steps complete a ballad, sealed with a shu-red 一首 stamp and saved to the localStorage archive (browse, read, discard). All interactions emit pure WebAudio (climbing pentatonic scale + completion arpeggio), no assets. Verified in-browser: step counter, lyric engine, archive persistence, modal, sound toggle, keyboard (space/n/Esc), and 375px mobile layout with no overflow or console errors.
